name: Yuki
source: Yuki is the protagonist's gentle childhood friend, born and raised in Millhaven. Quiet and thoughtful, she helps at Harmony Farm and has a habit of putting other people before herself. Reconnecting after his return gives them a chance to turn their long friendship into something more, while the wealthy merchant Marcus takes an interest in her.
